skills.grammarMd:
Ask **Hewa çawa ye?** — What is the weather like?

- *Hewa sar e.* It is cold. · *Hewa germ e.* It is warm.
- *Baran dibare.* It is raining (the rain falls). · *Berf dibare.* It is snowing.
- *Roj derdikeve.* The sun is coming out. · *Ba tê.* The wind is blowing.
- *Hewa ewrî ye.* It is cloudy.

The seasons: *bihar* spring · *havîn* summer · *payîz* autumn · *zivistan* winter. “In winter” is **di zivistanê de** or simply **zivistanê**: *Zivistanê berf gelek e.* In winter there is a lot of snow.

skills.grammarMd:
The future is the **subjunctive** with **ê** after the subject:

- *Ez ê biçim.* I will go. · *Em ê bibînin.* We will see.
- *Tu yê bêyî?* Will you come? (**yê** after a vowel)
- *Ew ê çay vexwe.* She will drink tea.

In writing you also see **dê**: *Ez dê sibe bêm.* I will come tomorrow.

Not: *Ez ê neçim.* I will not go. · *Ew ê nexwe.* He won’t eat.

Time words for the future: *sibe* tomorrow · *hefteya bê* next week · *sala bê* next year · *piştre* afterwards.

skills.grammarMd:
**dixwazim** (I want) is followed by a verb in the subjunctive:

- *Ez dixwazim biçim.* I want to go.
- *Tu dixwazî govendê bigirî?* Do you want to dance the govend?

To want **someone else** to do it, add **ku** and their subject:

- *Ez dixwazim ku tu bêyî.* I want you to come.
- *Xezal dixwaze ku Hamo serçopî be.* Xezal wants Hamo to lead the dance. (**be**: the subjunctive of “is”)

The same works with *divê* and *dikarim*, which you know, and with *hez dikim*: *Ez hez dikim stranan bibêjim.* I like singing songs.

skills.grammarMd:
Many Kurdish wishes end with **be**, the subjunctive of “is”: *may it be…*

- *Newroza we pîroz be!* Happy Newroz (to you all)! — answered with *Ya we jî pîroz be!*
- *Cejna te pîroz be!* Happy holiday!

- *Rojbûna te pîroz be!* Happy birthday!

On the day itself everyone speaks in the future: *Em ê agir vêxin. Ciwan dê di ser agir re baz bidin. Em ê govendê bigirin.* We will light the fire. The young will jump over it. We will dance.

lines.en: The fire is slowly dying. Look: my father is taking out his flute.

lines.text: Ev bilûra wî ya kevn e?
lines.en: Is this his old flute?

lines.text: Erê. Û ev stran ji bo min û Lorînê ye.
lines.en: Yes. And this song is for Lorîn and me.

lines.text: Ji bo we? Wek soza wî?
lines.en: For you? Like his promise?

lines.text: Erê, soza wî ya kevn. Hemû gund bêdeng e, heta Hevalo jî.
lines.en: Yes, his old promise. The whole village is silent, even Hevalo.

lines.text: Çi mirovekî dilovan e! Binêre, niha ew bilûrê dide te!
lines.en: What a kind man! Look, now he’s giving you the flute!

lines.text: Ew dibêje: «Stranê bidomîne, kurê min.»
lines.en: He says: “Keep the song going, my son.”

lines.text: Û diya te? Ew digirî?
lines.en: And your mother? Is she crying?

lines.text: Ew bi dizî hêsirên xwe paqij dike, û dibêje: «Dûman e.»
lines.en: She is quietly wiping her tears, and she says: “It’s the smoke.”

lines.text: Û tu, xalo? Tu jî digirî?
lines.en: And you, Xalo? Are you crying too?

lines.text: Ez? Na. Dûman di çavên min de ye.
lines.en: Me? No. There’s smoke in my eyes.

payload.title: Bilûra bavê min

lines.text: Baş e. Niha ez ê bilûrê lêxim!
lines.en: All right. Now I’ll play the flute!

lines.text: Xalo… ev deng gelek nebaş e!
lines.en: Xalo… this sound is very bad!

lines.text: Bilûr kevn e. Deng ne yê min e, yê bilûrê ye!
lines.en: The flute is old. The sound isn’t mine, it’s the flute’s!

lines.text: Binêre, Hevalo ditirse! Û bavê te dikene.
lines.en: Look, Hevalo is scared! And your father is laughing.

lines.text: Lê binêre… Dapîr bi dizî strana bavê te dibêje!
lines.en: But look… Dapîr is quietly singing your father’s song!

lines.text: Strana bavê min? Ew vê stranê ji ku dizane?
lines.en: My father’s song? How does she know this song?

lines.text: Ez nizanim. Lê ew dikene… û sor dibe!
lines.en: I don’t know. But she’s smiling… and blushing!

lines.text: Dapîr sor dibe? Ev tiştekî nû ye.
lines.en: Dapîr, blushing? That’s something new.

lines.text: Sibeh baş, xalo! Tu çima hîn di nivînê de yî?
lines.en: Good morning, Xalo! Why are you still in bed?

lines.text: Were vir! Ez nikarim rabim! Pişta min… êşeke giran e.
lines.en: Come here! I can’t get up! My back… it’s a bad pain.
